newsitem.title: USA: Nortek sees solid results for rest of 1997.
newsitem.headline: Nortek sees solid results for rest of 1997.

text.p: Nortek Inc said Wednesday it expects solid earnings and sales for the remainder of the year despite a temporary dilution from higher interest costs on the company's new 10-year note.

"As for the remainder of 1997, assuming a reasonable interest and inflation environment, we expect housing starts and sales of existing homes to be decent, and we believe that high employment and consumer confidence will support a strong remodeling market," said chairman and chief executive officer Richard Bready.

"This is a solid outlook for both sales and earnings, that may be offset only slightly by a temporary dilution in earnings by higher interest costs from our new 10-year notes until we put that capital to work," he added
Nortek Inc Wednesday reported first-quarter earnings rose 54 percent to $3.7 million and first quarter earnings per share were up 85 percent to $0.37.
The company said sales were constrained by a one-week-shorter shipping period and a cutback of some product-line offerings.
